_note: Structural A/B experiments. The pipeline can cut two openers/hooks of one script; ship both as Shorts, let retention pick the winner, then bank the rule into craft_ledger.json. Each experiment: hypothesis, two variants (slug or hook text), metric, and result once measured.
protocol: 1. Pick ONE variable to test (hook type, opener length, title, thumbnail).
2. Build variant A and variant B differing ONLY in that variable (same concept, same body).
3. Publish both within the same window; let each accrue >=200 views.
4. Compare avg_view_pct (retention is the true signal) and 48h view velocity.
5. Bank the winner as a rule in craft_ledger.json; retire the loser pattern.
